definitions.explanation: A person, typically a child, who cries frequently or easily. Can be used teasingly or descriptively.

examples.japanese: あの{子|こ}はなきむしだ。
{小|ちい}さい{頃|ころ}はなきむしだったけど、{今|いま}は{強|つよ}くなった。
examples.english: I was a crybaby when I was little, but now I've become strong.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {泣|な}き{虫|むし}.

WORD FORMATION: {泣|な}き (crying) + {虫|むし} (bug). The むし suffix is used in personality descriptions (similar to {弱虫|よわむし} 'coward').

USAGE: Often used by children to tease each other. Can also be used self-deprecatingly by adults.

RELATED WORDS:
- {弱虫|よわむし} (coward, weakling)
- {意気地|いくじ}なし (coward)
- {甘|あま}えん{坊|ぼう} (spoiled child)
